text: Illustrate the story here: June's Bike Shop June sells bikes. She will give you such a nice price you will not think twice. Steve and Grace come to June's shop to get bikes. "I love this red one, it looks fast," said Steve. "I love this blue one, it looks fun," said Grace. "Can you give us a good price," asks Grace. "Done and done," said June. Steve and Grace smile and ride off with their bikes.
